annotations.title: Match a shopping list to products

description: Matches each line of a Hebrew shopping list to a product in Ramzii's catalog: the product found for each line, the lines that need the person to choose between close options (with the options), the lines that were not recognised, the date of the catalog, and a link that opens the list on Ramzii. Example list: "קוטג' 5%\nבמבה\nשמן זית".

list.description: The shopping list, one product per line, as the person wrote it, in Hebrew. Quantities may lead or follow (e.g. "2 חלב 3%", "עגבניות 1.5 ק"ג"). Up to 40 lines.

name: match_list

data_date.description: Israeli day (YYYY-MM-DD) of the oldest price in the answer.

open_url.description: A www.ramzii.co.il link that opens this answer.

title: Match a shopping list to products
